summary: Backend-only regression + new coverage for the Stripe checkout error-hardening in POST /api/checkout/tier/session and tier_catalog.create_tier_checkout_session. Added 3 new tests to test_tier_provisioning_helper.py (InvalidRequestError raised at helper layer, unknown tier_key -> 422 at API layer, TimeoutError branch via asyncio.wait_for monkeypatch). All 36 tests pass (22 + 11 existing + 3 new). Live curl confirms happy path (kickstart_1) returns cs_live_ URL in 0.38s, consent-false returns 400 with Dutch herroepingsrecht message, bogus tier returns 422 (Pydantic Literal validation). Backend startup is clean, no ImportError.

minor.issue: Unknown tier_key is caught by Pydantic Literal validation (422) BEFORE the ValueError branch in server.py can fire (400). Not a defect — the API still returns 4xx (never 502) — but the `except ValueError` branch at line 1496 is now effectively unreachable. Consider removing it or adding non-Literal validation upstream.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: prune the now-dead `except ValueError` branch in server.py:1496 or move to a non-Literal Pydantic validator to keep the branch exercisable.
critical_code_review_comments: tier_catalog.create_tier_checkout_session uses `import stripe` and `import asyncio` inside the function — works but unusual; top-level imports would be clearer and allow direct `stripe.error.InvalidRequestError` catch instead of class-name string match.

server.py class-name-based `if exc_cls == 'InvalidRequestError'` is fragile (typos would silently fall through to 502). Since `stripe` is imported at module top, `except stripe.error.InvalidRequestError` would be safer and typo-proof.
server.py is ~2717 lines — over the 700-line threshold; consider splitting checkout/webhook logic into a sub-module.
test_credentials: QA accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (qa-kickstart1..3, qa-compleet, qa-aiweek, qa-aimonth).
seed_data_creation: None — all tests reset users back to Presale in finally-blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 new tests added at bottom of test_tier_provisioning_helper.py cover: (a) InvalidRequestError bubbling from Stripe when price_id monkey-patched to a bogus format-valid string, (b) unknown tier_key returning 422 via Pydantic Literal validation (server-side path — proves no 502), (c) asyncio.TimeoutError raised via monkey-patched asyncio.wait_for. The API layer's 400/504/429/500 mapping is exercised indirectly (unknown tier gives 422, consent false gives 400). Live 502 -> 400 conversion for InvalidRequestError was not e2e-verified against the running backend because monkey-patching TIER_CATALOG in the running uvicorn process is not possible from an external test — but the helper-level test proves the exception is raised, and the handler code path was reviewed inline (server.py L1505-1528).
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verifies a defensive hardening change, no bug to RCA. Main agent's prior work (asyncio.to_thread + wait_for(8s), class-name-based Stripe error mapping) is functioning as designed.
